title: Foundry research source selected for canonical Library readers
summary: The existing Foundry Work now selects the exact N1/N2 public source, with a deterministic human and machine reading projection. Deployment readback is recorded separately.
intent: Make the completed research visible at stable Library URLs and traceable to one canonical source for project reuse.
reasoning: Foundry retains source authority; Library mirrors are hash-checked views, not a second source registry.
V40 changes only the selected Foundry Release; prior Releases/Snapshots remain immutable.
Private project packets are resolved through the existing private overlay and stay outside the public artifact.

changes.summary: Exact public source and honest distribution/evidence limits.
Hash-checked industry and valuation pages plus machine JSON.
Read-only source mirror pin and canonical ownership.

evidence.summary: 17 published industry records and two reviewed value-model/input records retain source references, rights boundaries and unmeasured values. Full source npm test retains a pre-existing external atlas limitation.

next_actions: Run the full Library gate and publish the verified generated site; verify the stable URLs and retain exact deployment readback.
Projects consume the stable Work dossier and pinned research JSON, retaining rights and missing-value boundaries.
